reviews.rationale: Mandatory pre-interpretation verification is blocked. Both maintained verifier invocations, using the specified source root and all three specified allowlisted roots, returned ok=false with invalid_source_roots before input enumeration or source checks. An exact-path diagnostic established that sources/jobs/hathi-gpo-orders/output/texts is absent from the supplied snapshot; the other two declared directories exist. No source text was read or scientifically interpreted. Consequently identity, complete operative inventory, first effective ending, earlier-ending conditions, independent commands, savings, chronology, later actor effects and current predicate have not been adjudicated. This is an unresolved input-verification barrier, not a scientific rejection of the claim.
qualifications: Exact input file hashes were independently computed and match the requested pins. claim_sha256 was computed with the maintained verifier's _canonical_sha helper on the exact card claim.

All seven quoted-reference occurrences, including every unique quoted descriptor for this card, equal one supplied SOURCE_BINDINGS descriptor after removing only its raw_path. This is structural equality, not byte or span verification.

Both nonquotation working_text.confirmations entries match all five declared identification pins (instrument_id, grade, sha256, text_path, text_sha256) in supplied descriptors. Those descriptors have not passed byte verification, so the clarification's prerequisite for scientific interpretation remains unmet.

The original mechanical reports are retained unchanged with invalid_source_roots. They contain no per-reference raw_path_missing or quote_offsets results because verification stopped before reference enumeration. No mechanical pass is asserted, and no offsets, raw paths or source directories were invented or repaired.

No original or actor source bytes, quoted spans, source-search coverage assertions, or page declarations were substantively verified. No custody or source authentication is inferred from structural matching.
Working-copy grade remains machine_read_government_printed_copy and acceptable_as_original remains false. No human certification or whole-lifecycle approval is given.
